def isSuffix(suffix, arr):
    p = suffix
    q = arr
    if len(p) > len(q):
        return False
    result = True
    i = 0
    while i < len(p):
        if p[i] != q[len(q) - len(p) + i]:
            result = False
            break
        i += 1
    return result

def main():
    # Test case 1: suffix matches exactly
    print(isSuffix([2, 3], [1, 2, 3]))
    # Test case 2: suffix matches at end of longer array
    print(isSuffix([4, 5], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]))
    # Test case 3: suffix is empty (always true)
    print(isSuffix([], [1, 2, 3]))
    # Test case 4: array is empty, suffix non-empty (false)
    print(isSuffix([1], []))
    # Test case 5: both empty (true)
    print(isSuffix([], []))
    # Test case 6: suffix longer than array (false)
    print(isSuffix([1, 2, 3], [1, 2]))
    # Test case 7: suffix matches but not at end (false)
    print(isSuffix([2, 3], [2, 3, 4, 5]))
    # Test case 8: single element suffix true
    print(isSuffix([5], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]))
    # Test case 9: single element suffix false
    print(isSuffix([6], [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
